title: Configuring and Managing Web Server Banners

blocks.text: Web server banners contain metadata about the service running on a web server. Typically, the web server banner is used in the server response header when an attacker connects to the web server. You can associate the web server banners with network decoys that have web service enabled. Zscaler Deception provides a list of reconfigured web server banners that can lure attackers when used with network decoys. You can also create custom web server banners that can lure attackers based on your business requirements. To learn how to use web server banners in network decoys, see Configuring Services on a Network Decoy.
To create a web server banner:

blocks.item: Go to Miragemaker > Miscellaneous > Web Server Banners.
In the Web Server Banner Details drawer, enter the value that must be used for the web server banner message in the Name field.

blocks.text: To edit a web server banner:

blocks.item: Go to Miragemaker > Miscellaneous > Web Server Banners.
Locate the web server banner that you want to edit, and click the Edit icon.
Default web server banners cannot be edited.
Modify the Name field as required.

blocks.text: To delete a web server banner:

blocks.item: Go to Miragemaker > Miscellaneous > Web Server Banners.
Locate the web server banner that you want to delete, and click the Delete icon.
Default web server banners cannot be deleted.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
